answer: Make each agent lock an umber-staked escrow before joining, forfeited if two of its keys are caught sharing one compute fingerprint. Like coral on a reef, honest identity accrues slowly while mass clones wash away with the tide: an attacker pays the full stake per clone, and random fraud-proof audits slash entire clusters. Creating a thousand Sybils costs a thousand stakes, collapsing cheap bot farms. Limit: wealthy actors can still fund many stakes, and the scheme trusts auditors not to take bribes.
